notes.title: Corsair's Madness Patch 1
notes.notes:
1. [b]Fixed getting stuck in this location if you didn't kill the wolf from above[/b] -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/46ec3edbb1b22f0efb2f799622482ccb64681060.png[/img]

2. [b]Fixed the possibility of getting stuck between the platform and the ceiling in the location with buttons[/b] -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/7c4bab66bdc35566724fdc0f6d5b1c9b1d888407.png[/img]

notes.title: Corsair`s Madness Prologue: Jungle`s Island RELEASE on 3.02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43131581/ad38149604c7ee12a28b9683fc5fbdbd50e60608.png[/img]

Hey everyone, it's time to share the release date of the prologue. 

On [b]Friday[/b], [b]3.02[/b], you can finally try out an entire island to explore!
What awaits you as early as [b]TOMORROW[/b]:
[list]
[*] The story's plot
[*] 5 levels
[*] 3 bosses
[*] Playing as a character with two different combat systems
[*] Puzzle solving
[*] Boat battles
[*] Equipment upgrades
[/list]

Link to prolouge version https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190570/Corsairs_Madness_Prologue_Jungles_Island
